newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates end reserve period lower.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates end reserve period lower.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates closed lower amid ample liquidity on Tuesday, the last trading day of the banks' two-week reserve period, dealers said.
Overnight rates finished at 19 percent versus opening offers at 20 percent and Monday's close of 19.75 percent.
"Liquidity was ample. Meanwhile, there were only a few takers," said Karoly Barath of Postabank.

Market participants said despite the abundant supply, overnight rates remained relatively firm because some banks may have decided to deposit their money in the central bank's one-week reverse repo facility, now at 20 percent.
Dealers expected overnight rates to rebound to around 20 percent on Wednesday when the new reserve period starts.
